results.text: DESIGN, MOLECULAR DOCKING, MOLECULAR DYNAMICS, AND EVALUATION OF NOVEL LIGANDS TARGETING BETA-2 ADRENERGIC RECEPTOR FOR ASTHMA THERAPEUTICS. This study investigates the design and molecular docking of novel ligands targeting the beta-2 adrenergic receptor [β2AR], a critical protein involved in bronchoconstriction and asthma regulation. Therapeutic Potential of the β3-Adrenergic Receptor and Its Ligands in Cardiovascular Diseases. The β3-adrenergic receptor is an exceptional member of the β-adrenergic receptor family. Recent findings suggest that it may play a more significant role in the cardiovascular system than previously recognized, partly through its potential anti-inflammatory actions.
